title: Round Knob Slider
desc: A native, accessible recreation of DRAMS 013, Round Knob Slider, with its original physical composition and direct manipulation.
hint: Drag the orange knob or use arrow keys.
css:
.d-drams-013{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:100%;height:320px;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box;background:#fff;color:#515151;font:400 12px/1.3 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;isolation:isolate;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .d-drams-013 *{box-sizing:border-box;font-family:inherit;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .d-drams-013 button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer} .d-drams-013 .control{position:relative;outline:none;touch-action:none;user-select:none} .d-drams-013 .control:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fa651f66;outline-offset:10px;border-radius:50%} .d-drams-013 .sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)} .d-drams-013 .disc{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;inset:0;will-change:transform} .d-drams-013 .white-disc{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f8f8f8,#e6e6e6);box-shadow:inset 1px 2px 3px #fff,inset -1px -2px 3px #d9d9d9,9px 12px 15px #00000026,2px 3px 3px #0000001a} .d-drams-013 .orange-dot{position:absolute;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#fb641f} .d-drams-013 .mark{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;font-size:13px;line-height:1;color:#555;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)} .d-drams-013 .sphere{border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 31% 23%,#fff 0%,#f5f5f5 17%,#dfdfdf 47%,#a4a4a4 93%);box-shadow:inset 1px 2px 3px #fff7,0 9px 12px #00000016} .d-drams-013 .sphere:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:45%;top:45%;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff651f} .d-drams-013 button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fa651f66;outline-offset:5px}
.d-drams-013 .round-slider{position:relative;width:200px;height:42px}.d-drams-013 .track{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:17px;height:8px;border-radius:8px;background:#ededed}.d-drams-013 .thumb{position:absolute;left:calc(var(--value,0)*1.62px);top:2px;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#ff8849,#ee5811);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px #ffa876,3px 5px 8px #0002;pointer-events:none}.d-drams-013 input.control{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:42px;opacity:0;margin:0;cursor:ew-resize}.d-drams-013 .round-slider:focus-within{outline:2px solid #fa651f44;outline-offset:8px;border-radius:24px}
prompt: Recreate the Round Knob Slider composition from https://drams.framer.website/drams/013 as standalone HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a native 300 by 320 white stage. Preserve its proportions, gentle physical materials, interaction states and keyboard access. Use locally bundled Inter for labels and tabular numerical values. Drag the orange knob or use arrow keys.
